verdict.rationale: Ledgy has a documented API: OAuth 2.0 service accounts and operations such as auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference, try-it console or runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The axis applies to an API-bearing SaaS product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
